title: How to Create a TikTok Shop in 2026: Seller Center Setup, Creator Tools, and First Sale Guide
summary: Step-by-step guide to creating a TikTok Shop: set up your seller account, master the Seller Center and app, and connect with creators to drive sales in 2026.
body_markdown:
## Mastering TikTok Shop Seller Center and the Seller Mobile App


Seller Center is your operations hub after account approval. Use its dashboard to check shop performance, maintain product information, fulfill orders, and review policy or account notifications. Check pending tasks daily, then investigate changes in traffic, cancellations, and product availability before they affect customer experience. TikTok’s Seller Center guidance is the reference for current menus and market-specific rules, since available tools can vary by region and account status.


### Seller Center Dashboard Tour: What Each Section Does


The overview dashboard brings together shop alerts and performance indicators. Open the product area to manage listings and inventory, the order area to process purchases, and analytics to review traffic and sales trends. Check account health and policy notifications regularly: unresolved violations or missing tasks can affect shop operations. Use the dashboard as a work queue as well as a reporting screen. Assign an owner to recurring tasks, including listing updates, order exceptions, and customer messages, so actions do not get lost between teams.


### Adding and Optimizing Your First Product Listings


In the product section, add a clear title, accurate category, product description, price, available quantity, and compliant images. Include details shoppers need to choose, such as dimensions, materials, included items, and care instructions. Select the correct options for variations like size or color, and verify that each variation has the right price and inventory. Avoid unsupported claims and check category-specific rules before submission. Review the listing on a mobile screen: the main image should identify the item quickly, and the opening lines of the description should explain its practical value.


### Configuring Shipping, Fulfillment, and Commissions


Set shipping methods, dispatch timelines, package details, and return preferences according to the options available in Seller Center. Choose a fulfillment approach your team can meet consistently, then test the workflow from order notification through carrier handoff. Keep inventory counts synchronized with stock on hand to reduce cancellations. Price products after accounting for commission, shipping, packaging, returns, and product costs.


### Managing Orders On the Go with the TikTok Shop App


The TikTok Shop app gives sellers a mobile way to monitor shop activity and handle time-sensitive tasks. Use it to check order status, review notifications, track inventory concerns, and respond to customer needs away from a desktop. Mobile access helps with alerts and quick decisions, while detailed listing edits and reporting may be easier on a larger screen. Protect account access with individual authorized logins where available, and turn on relevant notifications so new orders and exceptions receive prompt attention.


### Desktop and Mobile: Practical Tradeoffs


#### Pros


- Seller Center supports detailed catalog, fulfillment, and performance management.
- The mobile app helps you monitor orders and alerts while away from your workstation.


#### Cons


- Menu availability and features can differ by market or account.
- Small-screen editing can slow down detailed listing and reporting work.
